metadata.title: Omnibus Professional Seed: High-Demand Gateway Standards
metadata.notes: The final omnibus of essential gateway certifications for the modern economy.

nodes.title: CompTIA A+ (220-1101/1102 Mapping)
nodes.description: The industry standard for establishing a career in IT. Hardware, networking, mobile devices, operating systems, and security troubleshooting.

nodes.title: CompTIA Network+ (N10-008 Mapping)
nodes.description: Essential networking knowledge. Network architecture, operations, security, and troubleshooting on physical and virtual networks.

nodes.title: HubSpot Content Marketing Certification
nodes.description: Content creation, promotion, and analysis. Inbound marketing strategy and storytelling for the digital mesh.

nodes.title: OSHA 30-Hour General Industry Safety
nodes.description: Comprehensive safety for supervisors and workers. Hazard recognition, avoidance, and prevention across all industrial sectors.

nodes.title: FINRA Securities Industry Essentials (SIE)
nodes.description: Foundational knowledge of the securities industry. Products, risks, and regulatory agencies. Mapping sovereign treasury logic to securities law.

nodes.title: TRUE Advisor (Zero Waste Professional)
nodes.description: Standard for resource management and zero waste. Strategies for total material closure and circular economic operations.

edges.rationale: Google IT Support mastery covers 95% of the CompTIA A+ core domains.
Network+ assumes mastery of basic hardware and OS troubleshooting found in A+.
Advanced OSHA 30 requires the foundational 10-hour outreach as a prerequisite.
Polymer sorting and detritivore feeding provide the practical intuition for zero-waste management.
